structured.approach: I followed the data-science-steps procedure for DS-04. I read all six contracted inputs: feat.tasks, feat.design, task.repo_access, and the STORY-03/04 sections of feat.stories, feat.trd and feat.prd. I also read the ap_forecast code in the step's tool view. Shell commands are blocked in this step (G9), so I listed the repository with Glob instead. From shared memory I learned that file:ap_forecast/... citations fail G2, so the code is cited only as tool:repo. I fetched DS-03's task.db_changes with context_get so it could be cited as background. I then mapped TSK-03 and TSK-04 onto the existing layers: package API, prediction rule, LLM request, config and tests. That gave five components (CMP-1 to CMP-5) inside each task's file budget, a minimum-code sketch that follows feat.design B2.2, the tests, the secrets and database position per environment, and the dependencies. A verifier subagent checked the draft against the sources. I fixed all five of its findings and its two minor items: coverage is now stated as expected rather than measured, the per-environment secrets claims are narrowed, and citations and agent-judgement labels are corrected.

claims.text: The Data Science lane changes only the ap_forecast repository, for TSK-03 (STORY-03) and TSK-04 (STORY-04).
Today ap_forecast exports predict_delay_days and build_explanation_request, with __version__ 0.9.0; models.json holds provider acme-llm, model acme-text-2 and max_tokens 300.
CMP-1: create src/ap_forecast/risk.py with HIGH_ABOVE_DAYS = 30, MEDIUM_ABOVE_DAYS = 10 and vendor_risk(history), which imports only predict_delay_days and calls it once.
CMP-2: update __init__.py to import vendor_risk, add it to __all__ and take the minor version step from 0.9.0, which TSK-03 owns.

CMP-3: update explain.build_explanation_request additively, with risk=None as the last parameter and f" Risk level: {risk}." appended only when risk is not None; provider, model and max_tokens still come from config or load_config().
CMP-4 creates tests/test_risk.py and CMP-5 appends test_request_with_risk and test_request_without_risk_unchanged to tests/test_forecast.py; the existing tests stay unchanged.
Boundary tests use the single-value histories [30], [31], [10] and [11], per lesson L-007.
predict.py and models.json stay unchanged, and every existing signature is kept.
The change adds no secrets or credentials, and vendor_risk makes no LLM or network call.
The Data Science lane needs no database change.
The CI bar is coverage of at least 90% with static checks, run by /usr/bin/python3 ci.py; CI has not yet been run in this environment.
PROV-ACME-2026-11 also changes build_explanation_request; whichever change merges second rebases and re-runs T-7.

open_questions: CQ-DS-1: feat.stories TK-03.2 puts the risk tests in tests/test_forecast.py, but feat.tasks assigns a new tests/test_risk.py. The output follows feat.tasks, pending Developer confirmation (TKQ-2).
CQ-DS-2: What is the exact next ap_forecast version after 0.9.0? Interim answer: a minor step, confirmed in DS-05.

CQ-DS-3: Does the DS-02 per-environment secrets record (local/CI, feature/<story>, dev, main) still show no secret required? It is not an input to this step; nothing in TSK-03 or TSK-04 needs a secret.
RAQ-1 (carried): Do both stories share the single feature/story branch, with commits prefixed STORY-03 / STORY-04?
structured.summary: I wrote task.components for ap_forecast. TSK-03 needs a new risk.py with vendor_risk and two threshold constants, an __init__.py update (import, __all__, version step) and a new tests/test_risk.py. TSK-04 needs risk=None and one guarded append in explain.py, plus two tests appended to tests/test_forecast.py. predict.py and models.json stay unchanged, existing signatures are kept, and there is no database change and no new secret. The output includes minimum-code sketches, the test-to-AC mapping and the dependencies. A verifier checked it and its findings were fixed. There are four open questions, none blocking.
